items.title: Nvidia earnings may come down to guidance and Jensen Huang's confidence
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is just days away from releasing second quarter earnings results this Wednesday, August 26, as Wall Street expects quarterly revenue of $92 billion. The Morning Brief's Jake Conley sits down with Barron's senior markets analysis writer Paul La Monica and Infrastructure Capital Advisors CEO Jay Hatfield to discuss why excellent earnings may still not be enough to impress investors in this stage of the AI cycle.

items.title: Should You Buy Moderna Stock Following Its Cancer Breakthrough?
items.summary: MRNA's cancer therapy scores a phase III win, strengthening its mRNA platform, while pipeline risks and competition remain key concerns.

items.title: Marvell, Micron, SpaceX, XPeng, Tesla, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks were mostly lower on Monday with the major indexes weighed down by falling artificial-intelligence stocks ahead of Nvidia key earnings and Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole comments later this week.

items.title: Moderna Sinks 7% as Traders Book Profits on a 392% Year-to-Date Surge; BioNTech Drops 4%, Merck Slips
items.summary: Moderna just handed back 7% of its staggering year-to-date run in a single session, and the question rattling traders is whether this is a routine exhale or the beginning of a painful unwind for latecomers.

items.title: Moderna Is Betting Big on Its Cancer Vaccine. This Is What Wall Street Wants to See.
items.summary: FEATURE  Top executives at Moderna have been projecting high confidence in the commercial future of the company’s personalized cancer vaccine even as Wall Street holds out for complete trial results. The market reacted instantly to the initial readout.

items.title: A cancer vaccine years in the making just proved itself
items.summary: Merck added billions in a single day after its Moderna-partnered cancer vaccine cleared a major hurdle.

items.title: Analysts praise intismeran’s landmark Phase III win, look to further data
items.summary: Eyes are now on intismeran’s upcoming Phase II RCC readout, which they say could signal the drug’s wider potential across the solid tumour space.

items.title: 1 Large-Cap Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.
